## Closed as a duplicate of #10475 — same file, same mechanism; the evidence is carried there

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T06:49Z. Read: this card and its full thread, and objectui `origin/main` `d999617`.

This card and #10475 are two symptoms of one mechanism: the default `object-form` arm (`SimpleObjectForm` in `packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx`) resolves section members with its own filter instead of the shared section builder (`buildSectionFields` / `normalizeSectionField`) the other five arms use. Here the symptom is the dropped overrides (`label`, `required`, `readonly`, `helpText`, `placeholder`, `visibleWhen`, …; only `visibleOn` / `colSpan` / `span` survive); there it is the member order. Same file, same mechanism ⇒ one finding, merged at first grading into the earlier card.

#10475 now carries this card's evidence (the three-key copy, the six-arm probe, the unenforced `required`), its pins, and a p2 grade because of the unenforced `required`.
